svg.text: Gated RS latch: QN = ~((S·E) | Q), Q = ~((R·E) | QN) · 2 × 6Zh2B + 1 × 6N16B
Each half is an AND-OR-INVERT on one plate: the pentode is the AND (S·E), the triode of Л103 is the OR (the other plate through a divider). S = R = 1 with E = 1 is forbidden.
Feedback divider: 470k ‖ 3.9 pF in series, 200k to −50 V, inside the cell. Л103 is one 6N16B bulb (Л103a: QN side, Л103b: Q side). The E pin is one net: it is drawn at both pentodes.
Heater 6.3 V on H1/H2 of every tube, all in parallel, not drawn.
